div.span:
Read top to bottom. Every solid arrow is a request, answered back on the same path.
Network A is the company's main work network: users of every network order through it.
Networks B and C serve special uses; Redis runs there too and this system manages it. Only cluster-client runs inside them.
One trace id (traceparent) runs from the adapter through the service and the network proxy to cluster-client. Dashed outline: planned.
